# SoraSwitch

An on/off setting that takes effect immediately.

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Category | inputs |
| Import | `import { SoraSwitch } from '@your-scope/ui'` |
| Direct import | `import SoraSwitch from '@your-scope/ui/components/SoraSwitch'` |
| Source | [`packages/ui/src/components/inputs/SoraSwitch.vue`](../../packages/ui/src/components/inputs/SoraSwitch.vue) |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Label text. It is the accessible name of the control. |
| `hint` | `string` |  | Helper text below the control, announced as its description. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the control, with the native `disabled` attribute where the element has one. |
| `required` | `boolean` | `false` | Marks the field as required: the native `required` attribute plus a decorative marker on the label. |
| `size` | `SoraSize` |  | Size. Where no default is listed, it falls back to the nearest `SoraProvider` `defaults`, then to `sora.config.ts`. |
| `color` | `SoraColor` | `'success'` | Colour of the track when on. Green (`success`), as on iOS, unless set. |
| `id` | `string` |  | Id of the native control. Generated (and stable) when omitted. |
| `labelPlacement` | `'start' \| 'end'` | `'end'` | Put the label before the switch (settings rows). |
| `controlAttrs` | `SoraControlAttrs` |  | Attributes, listeners and a `ref` callback for the native control, for example Formisch's `field.props`. |

## Models

| v-model | Type |  | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v-model` | `boolean \| null` | required | On/off only: a switch has no mixed state. `null`/`undefined` are treated as off. |

## Slots

| Slot | Slot props | Description |

| `default` |  | Label content (replaces `label`). |

## Attributes

class/style go to the root; every other attribute and listener (and `controlAttrs`) goes to the native control.

## Keyboard

- Space toggles (native).

## Accessibility

- Native checkbox with `role="switch"`.
- Never mixed: a stray `indeterminate` is cleared.
- The thumb position, not only the colour, shows the state.

## Styling

- `.sora-switch`, `.sora-switch__track`, `.sora-switch__thumb`, `.sora-switch__label`
- `data-size`, `data-label-placement`

## Example

From the gallery ([`apps/gallery/src/demos/InputsDemos.vue`](../../apps/gallery/src/demos/InputsDemos.vue)), where it is type-checked and covered by the end-to-end tests. `t()` is the gallery's translation function; the state it binds is declared in that file.

```vue
<div class="grid max-w-sm gap-1">
  <SoraSwitch v-model="dark" :label="t('demo.darkMode')" />
  <SoraSwitch
    v-model="dark"
    :label="t('demo.notifications')"
    :hint="t('settings.email.hint')"
    label-placement="start"
  />
  <SoraSwitch :model-value="false" :label="t('demo.disabled')" disabled />
</div>
```
